points.text: Mechanism close to H2O/Scissorhands history-based eviction; modest delta.
H2O and alpha=1 sum variant not included as baselines.
Related work misses training-for-eviction and trained sparse-attention methods.
'Global' score is short-horizon decayed memory (~640 tokens) versus long generations.
Motivating overlap analysis lacks chance baseline and covers short windows.
Qwen 2.5 citation points to Qwen2 report.
CAKE comparison uses only a component, not the full method.
Headline results only in figures; no numeric table or CIs.
'Significantly outperforming' RL-Full claimed without test; small margins.
Scalability claim rests on two 7-8B models.
'Higher information density' claim untested.
Appendix I 'compression as intelligence' narrative speculative from word cloud.
Training-free eviction and RL training halves loosely coupled.
RL-Sparse validated on one model, one budget, math only, only with G-KV.
No limitations section.
Efficiency results lack serving-stack details; full-KV baseline possibly unoptimized.
Throughput conflates per-token cost with time to solution; output lengths ignored.
40% decoding-time claim inconsistent with Table 2; odd Llama scaling.
Deployment cost of per-head irregular selection and compression latency undiscussed.
No larger models (14B-32B) evaluated.
Single training run per row, no variance.
Low-budget accuracy far below full KV; full-KV reference needed.
alpha and lambda tuned on AMC 23 test set; baselines at defaults.
Gain not attributed to global score versus redundancy and normalisation.
No variance or CIs on very small benchmarks.
Table 1 lacks full-KV rows, output-length and truncation statistics.
RL-Sparse trained at one budget, evaluated only with G-KV.
'Significantly outperforming' stated without test.
Observation 2 lacks null; analysis regime differs from deployed retention.
Retention ratio conditioned on correctness, confounded with accuracy.
Figure 7 RoPE/semantic explanation asserted, not tested.
'40% of Full-KV' inconsistent with Table 2 ratio.
Qwen 2.5 citation mismatch.
alpha and lambda selected on AMC 23; baselines at defaults.
Observations 1-2 lack chance baseline and use non-deployed regime.
Effective horizon short; 'global' and 'long-term' overstate.
No 2x2 ablation attributing gain to global score.
Retention ratio conditioned on correctness.
Position-spread explanation and 'wait'-token narrative asserted without tests.
RL-Sparse vs RL-Full single run with small AIME margins.
No full-KV reference or length/truncation statistics for training comparison.
Figure 14 validation set drawn from training questions.
SOTA claim not checkable without numeric table.
Distill beats RL-Sparse at AIME 512, contradicting 'significantly'.
Decoding-time statements inconsistent with throughput ratios.
Benchmark and Qwen reference entries mismatched.
CAKE comparison covers a component only.
Results unstable; gains on Llama-8B inconsistent.
Needs validation on larger models (32B, 70B).
Significant gains only at impractically low budgets; marginal at large budgets.
Lack of novelty.
Post-training generic and disconnected from global score mechanism.
TTFT overhead not analyzed.
Global score is an EWMA resembling H2O with decay; limited novelty.
Evaluation restricted to math reasoning on two datasets.
Only distilled DeepSeek-R1 models; standard LLMs unverified.
No comparison with quantization or low-rank compression.
No robustness analysis for alpha and lambda.
High optimal alpha questions utility of local scores.
Sparse training mask interaction with RoPE unclear.
Distillation has teacher-full/student-sparse distribution mismatch.
SOTA overstated; CAKE and LightThinker not compared in main results.
No comparison to StreamingLLM or Infini-Attention.
Needs general long-context benchmarks like LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack.
Memory and time overhead of global score not quantified.
Recent SOTA methods (CAKE, KVzip, RocketKV, ShadowKV, RaaS) not baselines.
Novelty incremental versus temporal and redundancy-aware methods.
RL objective is REINFORCE, not GRPO; no-clipping claim unsupported.
Hard max not ablated against smoother alternatives.
Sensitivity to alpha, window and interval missing.
Benchmarks math-centric; GSM8K, MATH-500, LongBench etc. missing.
No system-level comparison against optimized kernels.
No head-wise analysis.
Typo and Eq. 2 summation bounds.

P.summary: Mechanism close to history-based eviction; modest novelty.
Motivating overlap analysis lacks null and deployed regime.
Headline results lack numeric tables and CIs.
Eviction and training parts loosely coupled.
Deployment cost and compression overhead undiscussed.
Missing full-KV reference and length statistics.
Hyperparameters tuned on test benchmark; baselines untuned.
Gain not attributed to global score.

Q.summary: RL objective mischaracterized; clipping claim unsupported.
No system-level comparison with optimized kernels.
